> Key concept: choice of system

>

> ![](/tmp/import-p0oookqh/media/image30.png){width="1.2598425196850394in" height="1.0078740157480315in"}If pulley alone is considered as system, then the contact force between string and pulley becomes external force which will be acting normal to the contact points (different directions).

>

> In order to avoid the pulley-string contact force, the system should include the string in contact with pulley and little beyond the last contact point;
